Maya Patel: Ran a quick benchmark of the 40B quantized model (q4f16) across h100/us-west1 and a100/eu-west1. p50 looks fine but p95 in eu-west is ~2.3x higher than us-west :thinking_face:
Omar Khan: can you paste the run command and perf numbers? did you include KV cache warmup?
Maya Patel: command: `./bench --model 40b-q4f16 --region us-west1,eu-west1 --batch-size 1 --concurrency 8 --seq 1024 --warmup 300`
Maya Patel: results snippet:
```
us-west1 (h100): p50=95ms p90=140ms p95=170ms tpm=420
eu-west1 (a100): p50=120ms p90=260ms p95=390ms tpm=300
```
Liam Chen: interesting. kernel selection differs; the runtime picked `attn_fused_v2` on h100 and fell back to `attn_generic` on a100 for seq>=768. that explains tail.
Eva R.: was quantization consistent between regions? same artifact? also what was batching behavior during the run?
Maya Patel: same artifact hash `sha256:abc123` across both. batching steady; concurrency=8, observed occasional queue spikes in eu-west when concurrent test clients ramped.
benchbot: perf logs uploaded: https://internal.redwood/bench/1755554321/logs (csv + flame) :white_check_mark:
Omar Khan: two possible contributors: kernel fallback on a100 + noisy neighbor on the eu cluster. we should repro with isolated instance and force kernel parity.
Liam Chen: agree. try `RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT=attn_fused_v2` and repro on a100. if fallback persists, file a runtime bug. also test concurrency=4 and 12 to get slope.
Maya Patel: will run isolated repros tonight. preliminary sizing thought: to hit p95<=200ms target for EU, either scale concurrency headroom down (target concurrency 4 per GPU) or add ~30% more GPUs to the pool under current kernel.
Eva R.: from ops POV, autoscale buffer at 40% during night windows has been our current safety. with this model and q4f16 we probably need to increase to 60% until kernel is fixed. otherwise we risk degradation in bursts.
Omar Khan: action items:
- Maya: repro isolated with kernel hint and varying concurrency (1755554321 -> maya)
- Liam: add telemetry to detect kernel fallback counts per region and expose p95 delta by kernel (lchen -> eng-runtime)
- Ops: bump autoscale buffer for eu-west 40b pool to 60% (eva)
- If kernel bug: open infra bug and tag runtime/priority-high
Maya Patel: noted. I'll post the isolated run logs and a small table of p95 vs concurrency by kernel tomorrow. :memo:
deploy-bot: scheduled: ops will apply temp autoscale buffer change in eu-west at 03:00 UTC. CI checks green. :gear:
